status: post-results application of preregistered confound precedence; no changed thresholds
reasons: Phase competitive exact accuracy falls from .611 to .000 to .103 in seed22, .002 to .663 to .026 in seed77, and .671 to .051 to .001 in seed88; the phase readout difference mixes compatibility with unstable optimization.
Position scan fails the preregistered cursor-effect gate in all eight seeds despite high accuracy; the nominal readout factor is not functionally distinct in that cell.

Secondary saved-state analysis finds frozen-cursor output agreement 1.000 for Position scan and .978 for Priority scan. This corroborates, but does not replace, the preregistered interventions: cursor advancement is largely dispensable under the learned geometry.
mechanical_threshold_passes: Four cells pass the original six-of-eight numerical assay. These thresholds are necessary, not sufficient to exclude optimization and readout-degeneration confounds.
scope: Current parameterizations and fixed-budget scalar task only; no claim of inherent incompatibility or broad phase failure. No architecture, training budget, or original hypothesis was changed.
